args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs. Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 February.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- That saved report label likely needs updating to the new name so it matches the account.

Sofia Marchetti (Coastal)
